> **Heads up — Claude Code Academy doesn't accept external pull requests.**
>
> The maintainer is the sole code committer for every CCA repo. Community PRs won't be merged.
>
> If you've found a bug or have a feature request, please [open an issue](../../issues/new/choose) instead — it'll be picked up and acted on. For questions and discussion, join the community at the link in the [contributing guide](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
>
> Thanks for the interest!
